text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fwahahaha! That's how it's done! Well, 
Trainer, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gracious goodness?! Health and 
prosperity, round of applause?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, what do you mean by "are you 
okay"? As you can see, I'm in top 
condition...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Her running was incredible, but... those 
eyes of hers were definitely not normal.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You're like a completely different person 
from the old Fukukitaru. Are you being 
consumed by something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Swallowed up by luck...? Am I getting 
swallowed up by luck...? Me...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could something like that really 
happen...? Ah, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It really feels like I'm not myself. More 
like good luck has possessed me, and I'm 
just lending it my body.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Because I didn't really do anything. I was 
just cruising along and taking it easy...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's like she's possessed by a fox 
spirit... Giving up everything just to 
win..."

Stopping in her tracks, she's deep in 
thought. The luck she had believed in... 
was beginning to cast a dark shadow.

Our next goal is—the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Even after saying that, there was no reply 
at all.
